card.name: Linking words in disease-risk lists
card.fires_on: Commas, 'or', 'and even' and 'of' that come right after 'risk' or a disease such as heart disease or diabetes, where the sentence goes on to list more diseases or risks.

modes.label: List separator after a disease
modes.description: A comma or 'or' right after a disease name like heart disease or diabetes, leading to the next disease in the list.
modes.example: reduce your risk of heart disease<<,>> diabetes, and some cancers.

modes.label: 'of' after increased risk
modes.description: The word 'of' following 'increased risk' in warnings, before the named adverse event.
modes.example: NSAIDs cause an increased risk<< of>> serious gastrointestinal (GI) adverse events including

card.plain: It marks the small joining word or comma just before the next disease or risk in a list of health outcomes.
